name: Gemini 4 Neon
traits: Cuts down on redundant file reads and shares progress as it works.
Handles context compaction reliably in long sessions.
Records the lowest fabrication rate yet in internal Google testing.

advice.value: complex coding, analytical reasoning, and production-grade enterprise workflows

strength: Legal, tax, finance and spreadsheet work
weakness: Ranks behind larger, slower models on intelligence
resistance: Blocks cyber and biosecurity misuse in real time
art_briefs: a calm glass-tube automaton made of bent glowing tubing and frosted borosilicate, standing upright with arms gently open, holding a buzzing gas discharge tube in one hand and a small blue Bunsen flame in the other, with a miniature snowy mountain hovering at its feet, fresh carved ski tracks and a tumbling slab of avalanche snow on its slopes. Background: a giant pale sun disk over a flat salt desert at dusk. Coral pink, ice blue and charcoal palette.

a slender clockwork scholar made of polished walnut and brass gears, seated cross-legged on a floating oak desk, feeding a long ribbon of blank paper tape through a small brass reading-head machine, a tidy stack of receipts and a utility bill pinned under a magnifying glass beside it. Background: a huge ringed planet rising over a still night sea. Amber, deep teal and cream palette.

a serene porcelain figure made of white ceramic tiles joined by fine gold seams, standing tall and weaving a vast glowing grid of tiny coloured cells like a quilt that slowly forms a relit landscape picture, a brass balance scale and a neat bundle of ribbon-tied documents resting at its feet. Background: an endless pale dune beneath a wide halo of soft stars. Ivory, emerald and soft gold palette.

a poised conductor android made of brushed silver and translucent violet glass, standing on a quiet ridge with one arm raised, guiding a ring of small glowing helper lanterns that circle it, one mending a cracked shield with needle and thread, one tightening a bolt on a tiny padlock, one unfolding a map. Background: a single glowing orbit ring across a dark violet sky above a snowy horizon. Violet, silver and electric red palette.
